title: Waiting For The Range
dedication: For everyone who stood in the cold with me.
request: a book about the cold, and waiting for the mountains to come out

pages.heading: On the way up
pages.text: The road climbs under a flat grey sky, cutting through scrub and winter slopes. Nobody remembers pullouts like this one, only the long pull into the hills.

pages.heading: Standing in grey light
pages.text: The pine trees disappear into low cloud right behind the gravel edge. It is freezing out here, hands tucked deep into sleeves to keep off the chill.

pages.heading: Clouds in the valley
pages.text: We stand at the edge and watch white mist creep in, filling the deep floor below us. Above the fading ridges, the top of the sky turns warm.

pages.heading: The third morning
pages.text: After three days of waiting, the sky clears all at once. We pull close at the railing in the sharp air, watching first light hit the peaks.

pages.heading: Before the drive down
pages.text: The town wakes up slowly, stacked along the slopes in soft morning light. Below the roofs, the mountains stand quiet, ready for the long road back.
